visualCharacteristics: A row of image cards, each fully clickable, with a dark shade and the title overlaid on the photo.
contentPattern: One row per card: a picture cell and a cell with a link paragraph whose text (in <strong>) is the card title.
usage: Use to showcase customer testimonials or stories as linked image cards with overlaid titles.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for linked photo cards with a short overlaid title; pick cards when the card needs body text below the image.
